name: TanStack Query
covers: Rerail's own TanStack Query rules, from the TanStack docs and maintainers' advice, for query keys and functions that agree across files, one QueryClient per request, and safe server rendering.

rules.title: TanStack Query practice: in an app that renders on the server, make the QueryClient per request, never once in module scope
TanStack Query practice: return a new value from a setQueryData updater, never change cached data in place
TanStack Query practice: read query data from the query, never copy it into useState
TanStack Query practice: never use a Server Action as a browser queryFn; fetch through a Route Handler and keep actions for mutations
TanStack Query practice: write the dehydrated query cache into HTML with an HTML-safe serialiser, never bare JSON.stringify or superjson.stringify
TanStack Query practice: a queryFn or mutationFn that calls fetch() throws when the response is not ok
TanStack Query practice: every input the queryFn reads goes into the queryKey, also through a key factory or a queryFn passed by name
TanStack Query practice: one query key, one query function
TanStack Query practice: make a component's QueryClient once, never by calling a factory on every render
TanStack Query practice: give an infinite query its own query key, never one a plain query also uses
TanStack Query practice: invalidate and update the cache only with keys a query uses
